findings.note: The many arm reads « {count} de non-lus » with a hyphen, while the one/other arms of the same message read « non lu »/« non lus » and the six other occurrences of this word across the fr catalogue are unhyphenated. Same word, two spellings in one message; drop the hyphen for consistency.
« depuis ici » is understandable but heavy; the idiomatic French for "from here" (this surface) is « d’ici ». No meaning change.

« N’a pas encore activé Team Bridge » is a subjectless verb phrase used as a tooltip and assistive description. Understandable in a row context, but the namespace's other fragments are noun/adjective phrases (« En pause », « En lecture seule »); a noun phrase (e.g. stating Team Bridge is not yet enabled) would read more evenly. Style only.
